mapper.select: SELECT a.alias_id,a.account_id,a.alias_key,a.alias_name,a.menu_id,m.menu_name,a.created_at,a.user_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_menu_alias a JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_menu_master m ON m.account_id=a.account_id AND m.menu_id=a.menu_id AND m.del_yn='N' WHERE a.account_id=#{account_id} AND a.menu_id=#{menu_id} ORDER BY a.alias_name
SELECT menu_name FROM the_full_order.tb_account_menu_master WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND menu_id=#{menu_id} AND del_yn='N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_account_menu_alias (account_id,alias_key,alias_name,menu_id,user_id) VALUES (#{account_id},#{alias_key},#{alias_name},#{menu_id},#{user_id}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE alias_name=VALUES(alias_name),menu_id=VALUES(menu_id),user_id=VALUES(user_id)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM the_full_order.tb_account_menu_alias WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND alias_id=#{alias_id}
